experiments.title: Master Analog Electronics Laboratory Experiments
experiments.aim: To experimentally observe and analyze Wave Shaping, Rectifiers, Active/Passive Filters, Transients, and RLC Resonance.
procedure: 1. Connect the circuit under test on the breadboard or simulation workspace.
2. Adjust input function generator signal shape (Sine, Square, Triangle), amplitude, and frequency.
3. Observe time-domain input vs output waveforms or frequency Bode magnitude/phase plots.
4. Measure cutoff frequency, time constant tau, ripple factor, and quality factor Q.
precautions: Verify component polarity (diodes and electrolytic capacitors) before applying power.
Ensure oscilloscope channels share a common ground reference.
